description: Fetch the current real-time trending topics on Bluesky. Returns topics with display name, Bluesky's one-sentence summary of the story, post count, category (politics, sports, pop-culture, etc.), status, start time, and the representative accounts driving each topic — so "who is talking about this" needs no follow-up call. Entry point for "what is Bluesky talking about right now". Each trend is a feed: pass its feedUri to bsky_get_feed to read the trend's posts. Note: uses the app.bsky.unspecced.getTrends endpoint, which is not part of Bluesky's stable lexicon and may change without notice.

limit.description: Maximum number of trending topics to return (1–25). Default 10. 25 is Bluesky's maximum.

name: bsky_get_trending

cap.description: The limit applied to this request.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Guidance when the result set is empty or constrained.

trends.description: Current trending topics, ordered by prominence.

items.description: A single real-time trending topic on Bluesky.

actors.description: Representative accounts posting about this topic — the AppView returns five per trend. Pass a handle to bsky_get_author_feed or bsky_get_profile instead of searching for authors.

items.description: A representative account posting about this topic.

displayName.description: Display name set by the actor.

description.description: Bluesky's one-sentence summary of the story behind the trend. Third-party text, rendered quoted.

feedUri.description: AT-URI of the feed that collects this trend's posts — pass it to bsky_get_feed as-is to read them. Parsed from link; absent when link is missing or is not a feed page.

link.description: The trend feed's page on bsky.app (https://bsky.app/profile/…/feed/…), if provided.

postCount.description: Approximate number of posts about this topic.

startedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this topic started trending.

status.description: Velocity signal as Bluesky reports it, e.g. "hot", "cooling", or "stale".

topic.description: Record key of the feed generator behind this trend, e.g. "1d558a3bc9ff" — an identifier, not a search term. Read the trend's posts through feedUri.

truncated.description: True when more topics were trending than limit — raising limit shows them. Never set at limit 25, Bluesky's maximum.

title: Get Bluesky Trending Topics
